# Ted Kwartler

> Ted Kwartler (Edward Kwartler) is Managing Director of Responsible AI at Accenture, a Harvard Extension School instructor, author, and speaker. He helps enterprises adopt generative AI and machine learning responsibly, from large language models to trustworthy ML at scale.

Website: https://tedkwartler.com/

## Roles
- Managing Director, Responsible AI, Accenture (leads the North American Responsible AI practice).
- Instructor, Harvard Extension School (Data Mining for Business, CSCI E-96).
- Faculty, GSERM / University of St. Gallen (Natural Language Processing).
- Former field Chief Technology Officer, DataRobot (generative AI and large language models).
- Previously: data and analytics leadership at Amazon and Liberty Mutual Insurance.
- MBA, University of Notre Dame.

## Books
- [Text Mining in Practice with R](https://www.rstatsbook.com/): NLP and text analytics in R.
- [Sports Analytics in Practice with R](https://www.rstatsbook.com/): Applied analytics for sport.
- [Applied Sport Business Analytics](https://www.rstatsbook.com/): Contributed chapters.
- All books and free datasets: https://www.rstatsbook.com/

Responsible AI, generative AI, large language models, AI ethics and governance, data science, machine learning, text mining, natural language processing, business analytics.
